latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Upwork Freelancer Operations skill.

- Income and pipeline management tools for Upwork freelancers
- Automates job scanning, proposal drafting, and fit scoring
- Supports client onboarding, contract tracking, and follow-up sequences
- Provides income tracking, earnings forecasting, and rate suggestions
- Includes repeat business templates and platform health monitoring
